messages:
yuna: heads-up: onboarding run for veridian-v2-int8 shows zh-Hant->en BLEU drop (~-3.7) and broken ruby/bracket output for ja samples. cc @rahul @kai
rahul: can you paste a tiny repro and the eval command?
yuna: repro: "《源氏》の注釈〈るい〉は…". eval: `./eval --model veridian-v2 --quant int8 --locales zh_Hant,ja_JP --samples 1000`
kai: only in int8? fp16 ok?
yuna: fp16 baseline fine. int8 detok moves angle brackets and splits U+3008/U+3009 across subtokens.
rahul: likely merge-table/hash-seed drift during quant serialization. run `tools/inspect_merges` and bisect commits.
yuna: ran quick compare: fp16 keeps bracket as one token; int8 has split -> detok misplaces ruby markers.
rahul: i'll bisect and try regenerating quant merge map with original seed. if quick fix, push branch and run full eval.
eval-bot: quick run created: https://ci.redwood/runs/20456  metrics: zh_Hant BLEU fp16=27.9 int8=24.2
rahul: plan: 1) confirm mapping delta 2) regenerate int8 artifact with locked seed 3) run full 2k eval 4) if fail, rollback staging kernel.
kai: add unit test asserting U+3000..U+303F bracket atomization across quant configs.
yuna: filed RED-ML-5099 and opened candidate branch `pr/402-lock-token-seed`. will update when eval completes.
